svg.title: The uranium-238 decay series
svg.desc: Nuclides of the uranium-238 decay series plotted by proton number Z (80 to 92) and neutron number N (124 to 146). Alpha decays (red arrows) lower Z and N by 2 each; beta decays (purple arrows) raise Z by 1 and lower N by 1. 238U (4.5 × 10^9 y) α→ 234Th (24 d) β→ 234Pa (6.7 h) β→ 234U (2.5 × 10^5 y) α→ 230Th (7.5 × 10^4 y) α→ 226Ra (1600 y) α→ 222Rn (3.8 d) α→ 218Po (3.1 m), which branches by α to 214Pb or by β to 218At (2 s). The chain continues through 214Bi, 214Po, 210Tl, 210Pb (22 y), 210Bi (5 d), 206Hg, 206Tl and 210Po (138 d) to stable 206Pb.
